status: specified before new development fits and before opening large-user labels
decision: One bounded EB-NeRD experiment before changing datasets. Test missing response information and objective alignment; no further article-snapshot tuning.
hypothesis: Past click/exposure response, rather than exposure frequency alone, can improve Top1 on full slates and model-unseen items after feedback arrives.
data: Official small reference stream; independent large users excluded from the union of all small behavior and history users.
new_users: Stable SHA256('ebnerd-top1-feedback-v1:'+user_id) modulo 20 == 0. Select from large validation history IDs without inspecting outcome labels.
new_holdout: 2023-05-25 07:00:00 through 2023-06-01 07:00:00; new users, SAME calendar period as the old audit. Not a new temporal replication.
large_labels_policy: Never feed evaluation-user labels into features or train models. Freeze model bundles and selection before final evaluation; evaluate once.
feature_allowlist: Candidate IDs, request timestamp/device, strictly past fixed user click history, reference-stream candidate exposures and past click flags. No article file, title, category, publication/modification time, read duration, scroll depth, row position, numeric item ID as model feature, or current/future labels.
availability: Reference request time + 3600 seconds strictly less than scoring time. Feedback completion/ingestion timestamps absent: one-hour maturity is a replay assumption, NOT a production certificate. Predeclare 24-hour sensitivity.
selection: Among the two feedback arms, highest mean development Hit1 averaged over both folds and all seeds; no final-label selection. Final ensemble mean of 3 seeds; each seed uses its late-fold selected rounds.
comparators: past smoothed CTR at 1h and 24h (fixed prior strength 20)
primary: Expected Hit1 on all recorded inview candidates (ties uniform); no negative sampling or cold-only candidate filtering.
cold_definitions: model_cold: ID absent from all fitted candidate rows and original training history
cold_target: request has at least one clicked model-cold candidate; compete against ALL candidates
zero_feedback_target: clicked model-cold item has zero available reference exposures; cold priors cannot infer unobserved relevance
adapted_cold_target: clicked model-cold item has available reference exposure history

zero_signal_target: clicked model-cold item also absent from available reference exposures, reference fixed click history and that user fixed click history; log-sample novelty, not global publication novelty
uncertainty: Paired user-cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20261119; confidence intervals are conditional on this reference feed and calendar week.
success_gate: Selected model improves overall and cold_target Hit1 over exposure_top1 and both fixed CTR baselines, each paired 95% CI lower > 0; both dev folds positive vs exposure_top1. Zero-feedback results reported separately; no zero-shot claim from adapted cold performance.
deployment: No promotion of existing model registry; new model remains a replay candidate. If feedback timing not observed, never call it certified leakage-free production performance.
stop_rule: No test-driven tuning. If gate fails or only adapted cold improves, record the boundary and specify required at-request/versioned content data; do not keep optimizing this holdout.
amendment_reason: Before any fresh labels: enforce 1h feedback maturity plus 1h model build budget on fit and selection labels; draft fits excluded and archived.
latency_sensitivity: 24h delays reference online features only; fixed model was trained under 1h maturity. Not a full-system 24h availability certificate.
top1_early_stopping: Custom uniform-tie expected Hit1; metric=None disables built-in position-dependent tie breaking. ndcg arms retain built-in ndcg5 stopping; final arm selection uses expected Hit1.
